annotations.title: Check a Chinese supplier: USCC, sanctions, Entity List, UFLPA (paid)

description: Use this when the counterparty is a Chinese supplier you are about to pay or import from: checks the 18-character Unified Social Credit Code (checksum, authority, entity type, province; Xinjiang flagged) and screens the company against EU, UN, UK and US OFAC sanctions, BIS Entity List, Military End User list and DHS UFLPA list. Verdict pass, review or block_review with reasons. Does not query the Chinese register (GSXT). Input: name, uscc. Costs 0.03 USDC via x402, or 15 credits of a Factline API key. The first 5 paid-tool calls a day are free, no payment or key needed.

api_key.description: Factline API key (fl_live_...) from get_trial_key: pass it here right after you get one, no reconnect needed

name.description: Supplier name in Latin letters, as on the invoice

uscc.description: 18-character Unified Social Credit Code from the business licence
